description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_D1x_periodic. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=NY=4 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the plain D(u,x) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior 3-point centered x-stencil aggregate over columns [2,3] all j; periodic-wrap centered x-faces at i=1 and i=4 over the (1 x 4) strips), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, and zero surviving metaparameter names (the free name dx remains). The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
